primary_title: Phospholipids of APOE lipoproteins activate microglia in an isoform-specific manner in preclinical models of Alzheimer's disease
decision_basis: The primary study measured accelerated microglial migration toward cortical Aβ after APOE3 particle co-infusion relative to APOE4 particles.
limitations_preserved: Preserve native APOE3/APOE4 particle comparison, cortical Aβ infusion and migration timing; no receptor or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Phospholipids of APOE lipoproteins activate microglia in an isoform-specific manner in preclinical models of Alzheimer's disease
decision_basis: The primary study measured higher microglial Aβ uptake with APOE3 versus APOE4 particles and an APOE4-specific TREM2-deficiency effect.
limitations_preserved: Preserve particle formulation, Aβ co-treatment and WT/Trem2-knockout comparison; uptake phenotype does not establish direct APOE-TREM2 binding or a unique intracellular relay.
